_what: THE tuning file. Every knob the engine exposes lives here. Edit a value, commit, and the next cycle runs it — no code changes, ever. Missing keys fall back to safe built-in defaults.

arena_grid._what: The authoritative strategy space the arena breeds over. Widen a list and new strategies compete on the next hourly cycle; champions are still elected only by forward survivability on REAL trades.

_note_on_size: 8 drops x 7 targets x 5 stops = 280 MR strategies competing hourly. Sub-percent (0.5%) steps need a naming-scheme upgrade first (names collide at int()); widen here when that ships.

live_output._what: the handoff switch: master|all_quadrants|crypto|stock|metal|energy. enabled stays false until YOU flip it; the engine emits LIVE_ORDERS_PREVIEW.json every cycle either way so the exact orders are visible long before real money.

regime_gate._what: DOWNTREND behavior per book: hard = zero new entries (blocked candidates go to the REGIME_AB proof ledger) · soft = only conviction>=0.5 dips · off = ignore regime

prune._what: monthly data diet — dailies are never touched

regime_overrides._what: per-book per-regime LIVE tuning + participation profiles. 5.1 FINAL: each non-crypto book now runs VOLATILITY-NATIVE thresholds so it actually trades in its own market's rhythm — a 3% dip is a Tuesday in crypto but a monthly event in SPY. stock 0.7-1.5% (Cat 2 trading), metal 0.4-1.0% (Cat 3 gold rhythm), energy 0.8-2.0%. This is the three-categories vision: crypto=aggressive(Cat1), stock=trading(Cat2), metal=investing/rhythm(Cat3).

soft_conviction._what: conviction bar a dip must clear to trade during DOWNTREND when gate=soft

integrity._what: Phase-1 per-step sanity ceilings; symbols beyond them are quarantined from entries AND learning until clean.

warmup._what: pre-entry live-context gate, cadence-proof. June-30 ran 5-min cadence; at degraded 50-66m gaps a fixed high point-count starves entries forever — span is the real safety.

bench_books._what: 5.0 NULL LAYER (Law 10) — four strategy-free $10k baseline books: CASH accrues this APY knob (risk-free hurdle); SPY buy&hold; HODL 50/50 BTC-ETH; EQW equal-weight fresh-crypto basket frozen at creation. Marks from REAL feed samples only; excluded from Master + championship like GEKKO; auto-re-baselines after any WIPE_MARKER. Every governed book is judged as delta-vs-null, never raw P&L alone.

champion_rotation._what: 5.0 — the anti-flip-flop rotation gates, now LIVE-TUNABLE (edit → commit → next cycle). min_trades = forward closed trades a challenger needs; switch_margin = survivability points it must lead by. Defaults preserve 2.18 behavior exactly; lower BOTH to rotate faster as forward evidence lands — the rotation_freshness OBSERVE gate + Research-OS Q002 grade whether faster actually pays. Election runs every cycle, all books.

_broker_policy._what: Alpaca is PRICING-ONLY (operator directive 2026-07-07). Gates ONLY the run_all_harvest_accounts broker call in cli.py — the internal 4-book sim is independent and always runs. Flip true + commit to re-arm.

aggressive_book.name: GEKKO
aggressive_book._what: GEKKO — the aggressive probe book ('greed, for lack of a better word'). 5th independent $10k paper book on the crypto universe: SAME rails (integrity quarantine, knife veto, heatshield floor, fee-honesty), LOWER thresholds. NEVER funded/mirrored by the Master, excluded from champion governance. Chases low-hanging fruit AND manufactures the forward evidence (trade-quality, calibration, fee reality) the governed books need.

exit_policy._what: SELL policy. limit_sell_at_target=true models a resting LIMIT-SELL at each position's own target: it fills the instant price touches the target (a real order type), so a target hit between 10-min cycles is captured, not missed. Exits always use the position's stored target/stop, never the current champion's — a champion rotation never strands an open position with a moved goal. Set false for market-order-only exits.

fingerprint_strategy._what: Per-valuable strategy fitter (5.0). Each mean-reversion candidate is judged by ITS OWN chart: it must have dipped to ~its typical buyable level, it must not be in a genuine multi-day downtrend, and it must reliably recover (min_reliability). Its target is a realistic fraction (realism) of its OWN typical bounce, floored to clear fees — that is what lifts close-rate and win-rate. bounce_h=144 (~1 day) captures slow-market recoveries. trend_override=true lets a name in a strong multi-timeframe uptrend trade through a red book regime. Set enabled=false to revert to the blanket per-book profile.

reentry_cooldown._what: LDO lesson (2026-07-10): a name that just hit its STOP is barred from re-entry for this many minutes, every book incl. GEKKO. 0 disables.

heatshield_autotune._what: 5.1 — the one gate made ACTIONABLE by operator directive: when the measured shield-vs-tight comparison has ≥evidence_min forward trades, the crypto floor uses the MEASURED winner (clamped). mode:'off' restores the constant. Choice is stamped in HEATSHIELD.json; gates board shows WEIGHTED only while genuinely applied.

regime_exit._what: 5.1B crash defense (the July-11 slide lesson). auto: when a book's 15m·30m·1h all read red, HARVEST every open position whose net-now clears fees (REGIME_FLIP_HARVEST, limit-class fill, same cost model). symbol_override_min_conf: a valuable whose own MTF confluence ≥ this may trade through an industry red (max 2/cycle). Every harvest is A/B-logged; CONDUCTOR_REPORT_CARD grades saved% and prints the kill criterion. mode:'off' disables.

stale_capital._what: 5.1B stuck-capital policy: past review_h with head above water → FEE_CLEAR_TIME exit (banks it, frees the capital, never a loss). Underwater past stuck_flag_h → flagged 'stuck' for the report card; heatshield patience still applies (no forced losses).

conviction_sizing._what: 5.1B: wagers scale with earned confidence = 0.45×fingerprint bounce-reliability + 0.35×this book's win-rate on the symbol + 0.20×MTF confluence → 0.5×..2.5× the base fraction, clamped [floor,max] of equity. Flat-base twin logged per trade; SIZING A/B on the report card decides if it stays. mode:'off' = flat sizing.

regime_throttle._what: 5.1B: while the book's fast trio is red, new entries are capped per cycle — never march fresh capital into a confirmed slide.

vol_native._what: 5.11 ACTIVATION: per-name entry = clamp(k·σ1h, class floor, min(class cap, regime base)); σ1h = robust MAD of the name's ACTUAL trailing-1h moves (48h window). Custom-fits EVERY trade to the name's own pulse — quiet markets and quiet INDUSTRIES (the frozen metal/energy books) still surface their own outliers. Never looser than the floor, never demands more than the regime base. mode:'off' restores blanket thresholds. KILL: if vol-native entries lose to fingerprint entries after 60 closed (report card), turn off.

target._note: 7.0.2 GOLD FIX: target = clamp(the move this name actually reaches over the intended hold, fee_multiple x round-trip cost, champion base target). Metal/energy inherited crypto-shaped +5% targets they could never reach — the reason metal had zero trades. Scoped to metal+energy so working crypto/stock are untouched. A name whose reachable move cannot pay its round trip is skipped honestly. KILL: mode 'off'.

position_caps._what: 5.11 industry law: max TOTAL open positions per book — the anti-lockup governor applied to every industry. A new name must beat a held one for a slot; every cap-skip is logged to actions.

compounder._what: 5.11 WRAP: wager tilt from the confidence card's compounder_score (conf × swing × cadence). KILL via sizing A/B: mode:'off'.

venue_layer._what: 5.3 M2: cost = declared venue fee (rt) + measured spread + slippage capped at slippage_cap_bps. venue: binanceus|coinbase|robinhood. KILL: mode:'off' restores the legacy noise-floor model.

master_brain._what: 5.3 M7: the Master SHADOW-TRADES its own $10k from evidence-gated picks (top gate_pct percentile of live card scores), strikes within one cycle on a fast-band UPTREND shift, refuses long-hold setups (expected hold > max), and vaults harvest_frac of every realized win as non-spendable USD reserve. KILL: mode:'off' → pure WATCHING.
master_brain._mirror_canon_note: 7.0 FINAL R1: auto = Master may only open/keep positions a real book holds (canon subset, tagged mirrors). KILL: "off" restores the legacy parallel sim.
master_brain._note_703: 7.0.3 MASTER REPAIR: (1) allow_aggressive_mirror False — GEKKO NEVER funds the Master (the old fallback produced 11 ADA-USD trades and a 0% win rate from ONE GEKKO probe position; the crypto book never traded ADA). (2) mirror_max_age_min 45 — never join a book trade already in flight; the Master books the book's entry basis retroactively, so a stale join inherits the drawdown without capturing the entry. (3) reentry_cooldown_min 180 — no re-buying a name straight after closing it (the churn loop). (4) require_promoted_sleeve True — a quadrant funds the Master only once its own workshop promoted a sleeve on real closed trades.

crash_lane._what: 5.3 M8: a CONFIRMED >12% single-step move is a VERIFIED_CRASH — logged to CRASH_LEDGER with forward paths, entries cool off cooloff_h. reentry stays OFF until the ledger holds ≥20 observations.

discovery._what: 5.3: the Opportunity Graveyard (every rejection, resolved at +24h/+7d) and the Counterfactual engine (per closed trade: never/limit/held+4h/half). The system learns from what it did NOT do. KILL: mode:'off'.

fingerprint_coverage._what: 5.3.1 M11: how many valuables get their OWN chart read (scan_cap) and how many cards reach the store/UI (publish_cap). Was a hard-coded 500/150 — which meant 86% of the universe traded on a blanket threshold instead of its own fingerprint. Metals+energy always enter first (class quota). If a cycle runs long, lower scan_cap; the quality floor (T40) still blocks degenerate fits from acting.

geometry._what: 7.0 THE GEOMETRY GATE (Laws 21/22): p*=(stop+cost)/(target+stop) on every entry; stops CAPPED at ratio×target (capping narrows — never widens); honest-stop>ratio → UNTRADEABLE:geometry; Wilson floor (own∪cluster) < p*+margin → UNTRADEABLE:evidence. The heatshield refuses the TRADE, never fakes the stop. KILL: mode:'off'.

maker_entries._what: 7.0 MAKER BOOK (crypto/GEKKO): entries rest as post-only limits; FILL when a later print touches (we are PAID the spread, cost×maker_cost_frac) or EXPIRE with the miss logged. Order type is most of the edge on 1-3% moves. KILL: mode:'off'.

sizer._what: 7.0 GOVERNOR'S HAND (Law 24): ladder GREEN×1.0/AMBER×0.5+harvest/RED×0 halt; daily-loss + streak breakers; ONE-FACTOR LAW caps crypto+GEKKO open notional (10 alts=1 bet). Pre-registered, no discretion. KILL: mode:'off'.

calibration._what: 7.0 GRADED CONFIDENCE (Law 23): every prediction closed against its outcome; Brier + reliability deciles; QUARANTINED strips sizing/gating authority until re-earned. KILL: mode:'off'.

edge_surface._what: 7.0 CELLS: every close lands in (class×entry-regime×fit-state) with expectancy±CI. 'observe' publishes+stamps; SELF-ARMS to 'gate' when ≥1 cell hits min_cell_n with CI_lower>0 — a 7.0 ACTIVATION checkmark, not a code change.

retention._what: 7.0 LEARNING PERMANENCE (Law 26): evicted rows compact to docs/data/archive/*.jsonl.gz BEFORE any cap; DATA_LEDGER.json reports size·cap·archived per store. Small repo = compressed history, never discarded history.

floor_confirm._what: 7.0 (the July-17 lesson): in a DOWNTREND, dip-buys are refused until the name prints a FLOOR — the last stabilize_prints samples must hold above the window low. Mean reversion needs a mean to revert to; a collapsing tape has none yet. KILL: mode:'off'.

maturity._note: 7.0 FINAL T2: a name trades only with >=min_fit_events fingerprint dip-events OR >=3 resolved bounce-tries on tape (tape evidence survives resets). GEKKO exempt by doctrine. KILL: mode "off".

trajectory_veto._note: 7.0: free-fall veto, ALL books incl GEKKO (ZIL/WLD lesson). Dip-in-range buys; multi-window decline needs a printed floor. KILL: mode off.

news_tilt._note: 7.0: news pulse in the decision path. shadow=log every candidate (NEWS_TILT_AB.jsonl); on=capped conviction tilt. KILL: off.

regime_champion._note: 7.0.1: regime-conditional champion. In UPTREND/DOWNTREND a book prefers the best momentum (dir=mom) strategy from its own arena over the mean-reversion rank-leader (which would sit idle waiting for a dip). SIDEWAYS keeps mean-reversion. Forward survivability still overrides once a book has live trades. KILL: mode off = pure rank.

sleeve_promotion._note: 7.0.4 THE PYRAMID + IMMEDIATE SEED — operator: 'we want to immediately start with the best sleeves we have currently as our default starting sleeves until better ones show themselves and prove it.' With seed_immediately true, a book whose workshop has no sleeve at min_closes yet adopts the best sleeve on WHATEVER evidence exists, flagged PROVISIONAL so the dashboard never mistakes it for proven. A fully-graded sleeve (>=min_closes, positive expectancy) always outranks a provisional one. Sleeve behaviour is never altered — only selected. KILL: mode 'off'.

fee_class._note: 7.0.2 PER-CLASS FEE FLOOR (round-trip fraction). Crypto UNCHANGED at 0.2% (Binance.US/Coinbase taker ~0.1%/side). US equities/ETFs are commission-free; true cost is spread+slippage (GLD spread ~0.003%), so 0.06% is still several times conservative. The old single 0.2% global floor made gold mathematically untradeable (GLD reaches only ~0.22% at any horizon vs a 0.4% bar) — that was why metal never traded. Modeled fees remain a hypothesis until real broker fills validate them. KILL: mode 'off'.

fee_model._note: 7.0.3 REAL FEES: cost = published venue commission (in+out) + US regulatory on sells + spread MEASURED from our own tape + slippage scaled by regime and trade style. Replaces the 7.0.2 per-class 'floor' guess. Set book_venue.crypto to 'coinbase_adv' to see the honest 1.20%/round-trip picture if trading Coinbase Advanced instead of Binance.US — venue choice dominates crypto edge at this size. KILL: mode 'off' falls back to the class floor.

book_harvest._note: 7.0.4 FULL HARVEST — operator's law: 'we want ALL profits reserved into USD. All profits above fee costs and round trip slippage... anything after all fees should be swept into a USD reserve.' frac 1.0 sweeps 100% of every winning close into non-spendable reserve_usd. The pnl swept is already NET of fees and modelled slippage (the fill price is fee-adjusted and the cost model charges commission + regulatory + measured spread + slippage), so what is banked istrue  take-home. Working capital therefore stays near the $10k base and never compounds gains back into risk — profits are only profits when they leave the table. KILL: mode 'off'.

graph_gate._note: 7.0.6a THE GRAPH GATE, narrowed after a point-in-time backtest. It refuses ONE shape: lower highs AND lower lows AND price still printing new lows (DOWNTREND with no basing). VALIDATED, tape truncated to each entry moment so there is no look-ahead: 2026-07-23 session +173.76 -> +248.21 (blocks ZEC -74.45); 2026-07-24 session -175.14 -> -193.01 (blocks AMD +17.87). Net across 20 closed trades +56.58. HONEST LIMIT: that is 2 blocked trades out of 20 — the sign is right and the rule is defensible a priori, but it is NOT statistically proven at this sample size. An earlier, wider version of this gate (blocking DISTRIBUTION and '6+ down windows') was measured at -107.69 across the same trades and was removed. KILL: mode 'off'.
